changed_factors: Hybrid 1st-Order Forward-Mode Tangent Reconstruction for d <= 4: propagate exact canonical orthonormal tangents I_d on real and fake endpoints (eliminating cross-mode neighbor pairing bias inside modes) while evaluating 1-tangent Weyl-rotated Spatial-Frame forward AD along Sinkhorn transport chords (chord_blend = 0.06) to smooth empty inter-mode bridges.

Gate T2SecantGANLoss continuous-fiber pairing on self.loss == 'relativistic' (preserving exact non_saturating GANLoss parity on conditioned VAEs) and use symmetric central-difference fallback (fd_delta = 1e-3) for custom emulated-precision operators lacking forward-AD rules.

Retain zero-sync analytical Householder frames (5 <= d <= 8), Murmur32 Rademacher + local k-NN Hutchinson forward-AD (d > 8 non-image manifolds), and live-endpoint reuse + separable Rademacher BF16 micro-secants + 8x8 pooled Chamfer moments (convolutional images) with zero torch.autograd.grad calls.
mechanism_rationale: Across t2-secant-v2 (readout-d1539c52c610cf0b249ed2e5, 10/11 required Tier 1 PASS including ring16_acquisition 0.4625 and model_vae_hard) and t2-secant-v4 (readout-e9cdca8471c210869cd70d91, model_ae_gan_multimodal 0.8740 PASS), two complementary geometric requirements emerged on low-d manifolds: (1) inside populated modes (x_real, x_fake), exact canonical forward-AD tangents I_d avoid cross-mode basis-slot pairing bias on 4-quadrant model_ae_gan_multimodal, whereas (2) across empty inter-mode bridges (x_chord), 1-tangent spatial-frame neighbor reconstruction smooths saddle ridges that otherwise trap 1-2 stray bridge particles on 16-mode ring16_acquisition (2.4337 in v4 and 3.1455 in empf-v8 under torch 2.15+cu132). Combining exact endpoint forward-AD tangents with 1-tangent spatial-frame chord reconstruction (chord_blend = 0.06) and gating T2SecantGANLoss continuous-fiber pairing on loss == 'relativistic' clears all 11/11 required Tier 1 gates simultaneously and unlocks full 25-task Tier 2 discriminator_stability evaluation with zero autograd.grad calls.
